question_text: A metal bowl of mass 700 g contains 1 litre of water at 27 $^\circ$C. When a steel ball of mass 300 g at 120 $^\circ$C is dropped into the water in the bowl, the temperature of the mixture becomes 30 $^\circ$C. The specific heat capacities of steel and water are 500 J kg$^{-1}$ K$^{-1}$ and 4200 J kg$^{-1}$ K$^{-1}$ respectively. Out of the metals given in the table, what could be the metal of the metal ball?
